commit.message:
fix(motion): microlift pieces take longer chords only where they leave no sliver

The microlift acceptance (adaptive/lift.rs, lift_returns) compared the
lifted plan's worst reading with the spiral's and flipped on nanometres:
on the 60 x 14 slot 10 of 30 sub-micron twins read 48.0 or 48.5 deg
against 47.5 and dropped the lifted plan (the bare spiral then fails the
travel law and the slot falls to Offset rings).

The reading was not a rounding tie. A piece re-thinned to longer chords
(0.01 mm sag) cuts inside the arc it replaces and leaves a sliver on the
stock side; the next piece meets it as one or two rim samples the spiral
never planned, and which cell centres the sliver covers is chance.

A piece now takes its longer chords only where the planner's stock shows
they change nothing: they read within the bound and leave standing no
cell the piece's own chords clear (lift_coarse::cut, Raster::stands_over).
The acceptance keeps its law with no tolerance (lift::keeps): a lifted
plan reading over the spiral, or over the bound where the spiral read
under it, is never kept. 30 of 30 slot twins now keep the lifted plan,
each reading its worst where the spiral does.

rotary_adaptive's r6.2 neck levels (5.7, 5.2) were pinned refused for
travel on the same coin (on main one or the other is HSM-planned with
the openings 16, 62, 250 or 510 nm deeper); they are now HSM-planned on
microlift returns and pinned so, their dexel load (20.3 % D at the bore
exit) and radius 5.2's three 5.1-5.5 deg breaks pinned as read (#1050).

coarsen moves to lift_coarse.rs with the new test (lift.rs stays under
the 400-line law). Decision: docs/decisions/982-microlift-acceptance.md.

Fixes #982

fix(motion): hold the adaptive planning budget per margin attempt

The growth planner's running budgets (length, law 2; vertices past a
length, law 3) were summed over the margin attempts. A plan whose first
wall margin ran out a revolution before its fronts were done - a matter
of nanometres of ring geometry - was made again from a wider margin with
a whole attempt already charged, and refused for it: the rotary r7 bar's
developed level at radius 5.0 was refused at 22.5 k + 7.6 k tool radii,
and HSM-planned in 22.3 k with its openings 250 nm deeper.

Each attempt is now counted on its own (Work::attempt, at the top of
Planner::grow). The limits and refusal texts are unchanged; every
refusal on our fixtures falls inside its first attempt as before. The
r7 bar's level 5.0 and the rotary window's levels 6.0 and 5.0 are
HSM-planned, at 0, 8, 16, 62 and 250 nm of perturbation alike (heavy
twins in adaptive::budget::twins), and the rotary pins name them.

Stacked on PR #1080 (#982). Decision: docs/decisions/1051-planning-budget-edge.md

Fixes #1051

fix(motion): hold the bore exit on a coarse rim; spread the laps' kinks (held)

Held work for #1050, not ready to merge. The growth rings' disc phase
(circles out of the entry bore, a wall conforming to the rim) is read
on the planner's rim and on a rim twice as coarse (`adaptive::conform`),
the worse kept; the closing laps' fillet-to-wall kinks are spread
(`tidy::smooth_walk`). The r6.2 neck levels read 17.3 / 17.7 % D and
0 breaks (were 20.3 % and 3); the r7 twins post no break at 5.0. The
measured pins R62_LOAD_FACTOR, R62_BREAKS and BAR_50_BREAKS are removed.

Not mergeable: adaptive_hsm's hsm_report_full_resolution goes red - the
narrow slot's changed plan posts a retract hop that rapids onto a
sub-cell wall-side sliver (RapidInStock, 4 descents for 2 levels) the
planner's stock does not see. See the issue comment.

Refs #1050

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(motion): land a rapid only on stock the cut pieces swept; hold the bore exit on a coarse rim

#1169: the microlift plan read its landings on the planner's cell
bitmap, where a wall strip thinner than a cell stands unseen between
two rows of cell centers. The return over the retract plane rapided to
its lift with such a strip under the rim (narrow slot 14x60, one
RapidInStock). The plan now keeps the segments its pieces cut
(adaptive::lift_swept) and a rapid lands only where the whole footprint
is proved swept - a quadtree over the disc on exact segment distances,
refused where the proof does not close. The hop's landing prefers a
swept lead point; a piece starting where the tool stands is ridden on
to at the floor instead of a retract and plunge on one spot (the slot's
two extra descents).

#1050: with that settled the held fix stands (16e129bb): the disc phase
out of the bore is held on the planner's rim and a rim twice as coarse,
the closing laps' fillet kinks are spread at 4 degrees, and the
measured pins R62_LOAD_FACTOR / R62_BREAKS / BAR_50_BREAKS are gone.
r6.2 neck: 20.3 % D and 3 breaks -> 17.3 / 17.7 % D, 0 breaks.

Pinned by lift_swept::tests (sub-cell strip landing refused),
lift_tests::a_piece_starting_where_the_tool_stands_is_ridden_on_to,
adaptive_hsm::hsm_report_full_resolution and rotary_adaptive.

Fixes #1169

fix(motion): prove a landing against the cut as the verifier reads it (arc chords, 12.5 um)

The swept-stock proof held a cut 5 um off its planned chord; the
verifier flattens a posted arc at its gouge tolerance (10 um, inside
the arc) on top of the 2.5 um arc fit. FIT is 12.5 um, so a landing the
proof accepts is one the verifier's column reading accepts too.
